prompt: Let $f(x) = 5x$. If $f(x) = 35$, what input $x$ was fed into the machine?
hint: This time you know the OUTPUT ($35$) and need the input. Run the machine backward.

hints.text: This time you know the OUTPUT ($35$) and need the input. Run the machine backward.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Easier machine: if $f(x) = 5x$ and the output is $10$, the input was $10 \div 5 = 2$. Undo the machine by dividing.
The machine multiplies by $5$, so undo it: divide $35$ by $5$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Guess and check
steps: Try inputs: $f(6) = 30$ — too small. $f(8) = 40$ — too big.
$f(7) = 35$ — exactly right, so the input was $7$.

alternativeExplanations.title: ⚠️ Dodge the trap
steps: Feeding 35 INTO the machine — 5 × 35 = 175 — answers the reverse of what was asked.
35 is what came OUT. To find what went in, undo the machine: 35 ÷ 5 = 7.
